methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA signals intentional distribution of deep AI capabilities through community-focused education infrastructure, potentially creating peer learning networks that spread beyond traditional academic gatekeeping.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Young Richmond workers feeling AI pressure without corresponding upskilling infrastructure suggests anxiety without agency—neither depth of capability nor broad distribution materializing, creating displacement risk rather than opportunity.

signals.title: RC-RV partners with ed2go to launch innovative, on-demand workforce training programs - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: On-demand workforce training through ed2go platform partnerships enables shallow but distributed AI adoption in underserved regions—platform-mediated capabilities that democratize access without building deep local expertise.

signals.title: Amid AI, Quantum Tech, Chesterfield County, Va., Invests in Cyber - govtech.com
signals.signal_reading: Chesterfield County's strategic investment in cybersecurity and quantum capabilities alongside AI reflects concentrated public-sector technical sophistication in metro Richmond, deepening capability gaps with rural localities lacking similar institutional capacity.

signals.title: Virginia’s AI Data Center Gravy Train Shows Signs of Slowing - Bloomberg Law News
signals.signal_reading: NoVA's data center slowdown doesn't redistribute AI infrastructure—it signals saturation in the existing concentration hub while no secondary centers emerge, reinforcing rather than challenging the geographic imbalance of AI capability.
